page: Amazon Web Services r7gd.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by 64 dedicated physical cores of the ARMv8 AWS Graviton Neoverse-V1 processor architecture running at 2.6 GHz. It features 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance is built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and includes 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage alongside a 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench multi-core scoring and software compilation, as well as Passmark memory tests. Memory bandwidth is highly rated, reaching 253.52 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 116.88 GB/sec for large-block write operations. Database operations and Redis SET performance are also strong, with Redis handling 101.36 million operations per second. However, single-core CPU performance and small-model LLM text generation speed are relatively average or poor.

Given its high memory density, dedicated ARM cores, and integrated local NVMe storage, the r7gd.16xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high memory throughput and fast local scratch space without the overhead of external network storage. It is highly suited for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, Redis caching layers, software compilation pipelines, and static web serving.
